clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers Ше requirements relating to the performance and safety that is strength, stability and durability of bunk beds for domestic and non-domestic use. This standard also applies to single beds for use at a height of the bed base of 800 mm or more above finished floor level, irrespective of the use to which the space below is put. 12 This standard applies to completely manufactured/ fabricated bunk beds. It also applies to ready-to-assemble units; in that case the requirements of this standard shall apply to the assembled units.
